chitchat: In you get. Middle tub. Mind the step.
No, that one is too hot. That one is for Ferrous.
Towels on the left, and bring it back.
I have been in here since the sun was on the other side of everything.
Everybody talks in a bathhouse. It's the rules.
description:
She's in the steam and of it. Her skin is faintly, permanently wet, and it doesn't dry, and it never has, and in any other room in the world that would be a problem. In this one she can stand at the copper for nine hours without going down, which is why she's the one who does.

She talks constantly, to everybody, about nothing, and it's the most relaxing sound in the Thornwarren.

bye.text:
"Right."

And they go back to it, which out here is the whole of a goodbye.

options.label: This must take a lot of water.

look.text:
She stops, for the first time, and looks at you with real curiosity rather than any offence.

"Where would we put it?"

And she goes back to the copper, and after a moment says, in exactly the same tone as everything else, "You have got a scar on your back you didn't want anybody to see and I saw it in the first four seconds and I haven't thought about it since, and neither has anyone else. That's the whole of what this room is for."

root.first: "Oh, you're the one from outside." She doesn't stop what she's doing. "In or out, love, the heat gets away."

text_by_relation.close: She's already talking when you come in, halfway through a sentence, and you're expected to catch up.
text_by_relation.familiar: "I saved you the middle one." She had not, and she had.

water.text:
"It does and we have got it."

She is enormously pleased about this and makes no attempt to hide it.

"Everything off every roof, down the tanks, through Sill's beds, into the cistern. Best water for sixty miles and I get the run-off for the tubs and then that goes on the Netting." She taps the copper. "Nothing leaves. It goes round."

A pause.

"They have got a river in Coldwater and they drink out of a machine. Anyway."

clothing_layers: a wrap, permanently damp, and she doesn't appear to mind
